name: Pennylane
summary: Accounting and financial management for companies and firms, with AI-assisted automation.
description: Pennylane combines accounting, invoicing and financial dashboards for SMBs and accounting firms in France. AI helps with bank reconciliation, reminders and reporting. See pennylane.com for plans.
features: General ledger, invoicing and cash tracking in one product.
Dashboards for leaders and accounting partners.
Shared workspace between company and accountant.
